questions.question: Pointing to a photograph of a man, Rahul said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is Rahul related to the man?
questions.explanation: Only daughter of Rahul's mother is Rahul's sister. The man's mother is Rahul's sister. So Rahul is the maternal uncle of the man.

questions.question: If 'SYSTEM' is coded as 'SYSMET' and 'NEARER' as 'AENRER', how is 'FRACTION' coded?
questions.explanation: Break string into halves of 3/4 characters and reverse each half individually: FRA -> CAR, CTION -> NOIT => CARFNOIT.
